title: Parity_Run.panel_row is captured but never asserted; the settings-panel scenario ends at different focused rows per device
evidence: harness/parity.odin:246: `panel_row = ictx.panel_row,` — the only read of Parity_Run.panel_row outside the assignment; check_states (parity.odin:1131-1140): `case "input_parity_settings_panel":` ... `for i in 0 ..< len(devs) { if runs[i].panel_open { append(fails, ...) } }` — only panel_open is checked. The scenario scripts diverge: mouse = `evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .S}), evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .Down}), evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .Enter}), evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .S})` (Down → panel_row 1), pad = `.Y, .Dpad_Down, .A, .B` (row 1), touch = chip tap + `row0` tap + chip tap (row 0).
detail: The PR body claims the scenario drives all devices to an "identical end input-state", but mouse/pad end at panel_row 1 and touch at 0; panel_row is written into Parity_Run and then never compared.
recommended_fix: In the input_parity_settings_panel check_states case, also assert runs[i].panel_row equality across devices (or make the touch script tap row 1 / drop the Down press so rows converge).

title: Spec code-map documents an `a11y <mode>[,<mode>]` demo verb the parser does not implement
evidence: spec-7-3-accessibility-core.md line 67: "- `harness/demo.odin` -- `a11y <mode>[,<mode>]` demo verb". The shipped parser (harness/demo.odin:531-561) only accepts `a11y palette <name>` / `a11y reduced` / `a11y scale <pct>`: `case "a11y":` ... `case:` → `return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad a11y (palette|reduced|scale): %s", line)` — a comma form like `a11y deutan,reduced` is rejected.
detail: The committed spec's verb syntax does not match the implementation; combined modes require separate `a11y` lines, which the doc does not state.
recommended_fix: Amend the spec code-map line to the shipped subverb syntax (`a11y palette <name> | a11y reduced | a11y scale <pct>`, multiple directives on separate lines).
